title: Outage notices and customer self-service measurement
not_questions: We will not license Adobe Real-Time CDP.
Use our storm drill event log in the acceptance workshop.

questions.text: Describe how AEM Sites would let a duty dispatcher issue a precautionary notice for a single feeder district.
Explain how AEM Sites and Akamai would retire a restored feeder notice from the mobile page during a regional storm.
Provide an AEM Sites rehearsal for the shift change between a dispatcher preparing a notice and a supervisor approving it.
Show how AEM Sites would keep translated public safety instructions available if the current outage map is unavailable.
Describe how Customer Journey Analytics would distinguish a customer checking for restoration twice from two affected service addresses.
Explain how Customer Journey Analytics would use restoration events in Snowflake when a feeder is energized in stages.
Provide a Customer Journey Analytics check for the hour when daylight saving changes and call centre logs have ambiguous timestamps.
Show how Customer Journey Analytics would let incident managers compare self-service use across storm districts after boundaries change.
Identify the supplier manager who can authorize extra coverage during a declared storm.
Provide two client references that can describe your firm's performance during an extended utility incident.
State your company's overtime rate for an on-call specialist supporting our incident managers.
Describe your firm's handover procedure if a subcontractor is unavailable for the autumn storm drill.
